text:
sam: Heads-up: BrightSky pen test scheduled Tue 10-12 PST. Need ops liaison, KMS access window, and audit export plan. tagging @jess for RBAC, @mike for logs, @tara for evidence packaging. Any blockers?
jess: I can take RBAC. Question: do we want ephemeral assessor roles or static service accounts for the initial test?
mike: Prefer ephemeral via our KMS-proxied creds. Limits exposure. We'll need a pre-signed S3 bucket and CloudTrail snapshot window.
tara: Evidence packaging: will they pull logs or we upload? Prefer we stage zipped exports in s3://pt-evidence/<vendor>/ and grant temporary READ via pre-signed URL.
felix: Re: retention — set retention 90 days for the snapshot. Can we enable object-level encryption with our KMS key (redwood-pt-key)?
jess: Ephemeral roles + KMS-wrapped S3 objects sounds good. I'll create a role template. Need to know exact permission set: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, logs:DescribeExportTasks, cloudtrail:LookupEvents
sam: Awesome. @oncall-bot can you create a dry-run channel and schedule a 30m pre-window dry run 2 days before?
oncall-bot: Created channel #pt-brightsky-dryrun and scheduled dry-run for Mon 09:30 PST. Reminder set 24h before.
mike: For audit exports, we'll run:
```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-03-20T09:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-03-20T13:00:00Z" > ct-events.json
aws s3 cp ct-events.json s3://pt-evidence/brightsky/ct-events.json --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:...:key/redwood-pt-key
```
That's the sample we'll share with assessors.
tara: I'll prepare an evidence checklist and presigned URL script. Sample command:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/brightsky/evidence.zip --expires-in 3600
```
jess: I'll drop the role template and IAM policy in the dryrun channel. @sam please confirm the retest window cadence (typical follow-up retest within 14 days?)
sam: Retest normally within 10 business days, but can be flex. Let's aim for 10. Also reminder: no deploys in the 4h window around test unless critical.
felix: One more: make sure CloudTrail log integrity validation is enabled for the bucket (object lock isn't available). I'll add a note in the checklist.
mike: Logging question: do we need network packet captures? That'd be on prem only — not for hosted tests.
tara: Ok will include packaging instructions for both hosted and on-prem. I'll upload the checklist to s3 and link in #pt-brightsky-dryrun.
sam: Great — thanks everyone. Action items: jess: role template, mike: audit export snippet, tara: evidence checklist + presign script, felix: retention + integrity note. We'll reconvene in dry-run channel Mon 09:30 PST. :thumbsup:
